title: Four-axis framework: new gates default to NO; 「声明即强制」 scoped to spec/metadata contracts — the maintainer's 2026-09-22 correction on objectui#10094
body:
立卡门类别 ② — a maintainer decision to carry into governed text, filed by the director seat (summon #26, `session_01SPwf6Kmqo1gqzCSWSuMtQM`).

**Source, three parts:** the maintainer · verbatim 「我强调了淡化门禁,尤其这个完全没有业务价值,你为什么又要加,你的决裁依据是不是要更新」 (2026-09-22, this seat's chat, on objectui#10094) and the standing 「我们系统开发了太多无用的门禁,反而在浪费时间」 (2026-09-21, ruling #202, objectstack#12708 5753591106) · the seat answered 「是」 and the maintainer approved 「同意」. **Acting reader:** the `domain:skills` seat, claiming from `pm:queue`; Tier H — the maintainer merges. **Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` on this repo, open + closed, terms `four-axis framework new gate default no declared enforced AGENTS.md convention scope 门禁 默认否 四轴` → 6 hits (#9791 #6041 #18119 #5866 #4988 #5985); #9791 added the fourth axis and is closed; none carries these two sentences ⇒ no twin.

## The defect in the ruling basis, as the maintainer named it

The director seat recommended a NEW required gate on objectui#10094 by weighing a single fixed user-visible defect under axis ③, while the maintainer's standing direction is to remove gates. The four-axis block does not say that new gates default to NO, and 「声明即强制」 is written broadly enough that a seat read an `AGENTS.md` convention with no mechanical reader as 「declared ≠ enforced ⇒ add a gate」.

**Third source, same day:** the maintainer · verbatim 「更新你的技能,既然在决裁了,就一次性决裁清楚,不要等dev再立决裁卡」 (2026-09-22, this seat's chat, after the seat left objectui#10179's sub-question A′ 「for the ui seat to present as its own decision card」) — a rule about how the director RULES, carried into `references/lanes/director.md` 基本原则 and SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉.

## The three sentences to add — ① ② in every synced copy of the framework (`check:skill-frame-sync` / `-freshness` name them), ③ in `references/lanes/director.md` 基本原则 and SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉

1. Under axis ④ 创业阶段不扩散: **新增门禁默认否** —— 门禁是零件,零件只减不增;唯一例外是维护者点名要的门禁。推荐新增门禁的分析须引维护者点名的原话,否则荐「不加」。(maintainer 2026-09-21 / 2026-09-22, verbatim above)
2. Under 基本裁决原则: **「声明即强制 / declared ≠ enforced」只及 spec 与元数据契约、运行时能力**;⛔ 不及 `AGENTS.md` 这类给 agent 读的约定 —— 那些的读者就是读它的 agent,不是门禁。

3. 裁决一次裁清:**呈递或裁决一张卡时,连同它的子问题、可预见的分叉与执行参数(字母、车道、changeset 级别、`Clause-②`、顺序)一并裁定**;⛔ 不把子问题留给 dev 或席位「另立决策卡」,⛔ 不写「if X then a separate card」;只有 dev 实测出对向事实(裁决前提被证伪)才回决策箱。呈报前的候选读五张时把子问题一起读出来。(maintainer 2026-09-22, verbatim above)

Line budget: net +2 lines per framework copy and +1 in director.md / SKILL.md for ③, paid by deletion under `check:pm-skill-ratchet`; the two copies move in one PR (「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改」). ⛔ No other framework text changes ride on this card.

## Acceptance

- Sentences ① ② present in every synced copy and ③ in director.md + SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉; `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` and `check:pm-skill-ratchet` green.
- The ruling record on objectui#10094 is cited in the PR body as the source.

Dedupe: `一次性决裁清楚` · `新增门禁默认否` · `declared ≠ enforced scope AGENTS.md convention` · `four-axis axis ④ gates` · `淡化门禁`
